const int MOD = 998244353;

long long dfs(const string& s, int idx, int rem, int val, long long cache[][25][11]) {
    if (idx == s.length()) {
        return rem == 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (cache[idx][rem][val] != -1) {
        return cache[idx][rem][val];
    }
    long long res = 0;
    if (s[idx] == '_') {
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
            if (idx == 0 && d == 0) continue;
            int newRem = (rem * 10 + d) % 25;
            res += dfs(s, idx + 1, newRem, val, cache);
        }
    } else if (s[idx] == 'X') {
        if (val != 10) {
            res += dfs(s, idx + 1, (rem * 10 + val) % 25, val, cache);
        } else {
            for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
                if (idx == 0 && d == 0) continue;
                int newRem = (rem * 10 + d) % 25;
                res += dfs(s, idx + 1, newRem, d, cache);
            }
        }
    } else {
        int digit = s[idx] - '0';
        res += dfs(s, idx + 1, (rem * 10 + digit) % 25, val, cache);
    }
    return cache[idx][rem][val] = res;
}

        memset(cache, -1, sizeof(cache));
        cout << dfs(pattern, 0, 0, 10, cache) << "\n";
    }
    
    return 0;
}
